name: vpn-ui
description: VPN-UI panel integration. Although VPN-UI descends from the same code base as 3X-UI, it is installed under /opt/vpn-ui by its own deployment script and is managed independently.
ssl_method: acme.sh issuance into BaToHub state storage, including bare address certificates; the panel CLI is used only when it reports certificate support
template_method: the panel serves subscription content from its own settings; BaToHub stages template files and never edits the panel database
